attr.title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: OpenXRay
attr.desc: Open-source engine recreation for S.T.A.L.K.E.R. (Shadow of Chernobyl / Clear Sky / Call of Pripyat). Game data (gamedata + fsgame.ltx) is required and is not included.
attr.inst: Place your S.T.A.L.K.E.R. game files (gamedata/ and fsgame.ltx) into the openxray folder.
